summary_for_children: Al-Fath means The Victory. It speaks of the believers' pledge under a tree, of tranquillity Allah sent to their hearts, and compares them to a seed that grows strong.
environment_concept: A plain with a single tree where a pledge was made, and a field of seedlings growing strong.
architecture_and_scenery: Open plain, a single tree, a field of crops whose shoots grow stronger.
